name: Staff of Speaking
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 201
Aura strong enchantment CL 13th
Slot none; Price 57,200 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
When the wielder of this hollow wooden staff speaks or shouts, it reverberates with the sound of her voice, lending a booming insistence to her words. It allows the use of the following spells:
Suggestion (1 charge)
Tongues (1 charge)
Denounce (2 charges; Advanced Player’s Guide)
Glibness (2 charges)
Mass suggestion (4 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, denounce, glibness, mass suggestion, suggestion, tongues; Cost 28,600 gp
